verdict.rationale: Fireflies exposes a broad GraphQL API with bearer-token auth and schema introspection. It covers transcript listing and search, transcript details, audio upload with completion webhooks, active meetings, analytics, audit events and Super Admin team-wide queries. Its MCP tools add share, move-to-channel and soundbite creation. However, nothing claims or shows full UI parity, and several UI features have no evidenced API equivalent. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity commitment, API control of bot joining and calendar auto-join, Rules Engine/automation configuration, real-time live notes, and independent hands-on corroboration of coverage.
